app.title: GanttBudget
app.privacy: Your data stays on this computer only; nothing is sent to a server.
app.notSavedYet: Your project is continuously backed up in this browser; to be safe, save it to a file (Ctrl+S).

import.title: Import tasks
import.replaceWarning: The import will replace all current tasks ({{count}}). The project name and calendar stay. You can undo the import with Undo (Ctrl+Z).
import.errorsIntro_one: The file cannot be imported – it contains {{count}} error:
import.errorsIntro_other: The file cannot be imported – it contains {{count}} errors:
import.nothingChanged: Fix the file (e.g. in Excel) and import it again. Nothing in the project has changed.

error.tooLarge: The file is too large (over 5 MB). Nothing has changed.
error.unreadable: The file cannot be read – it is damaged or not an Excel / CSV table. Nothing has changed.
error.unsupported: Only .xlsx and .csv files can be imported. Nothing has changed.
error.empty: The table contains no tasks (the first row must be a header with a Name column).
error.missingName: The first row (table header) has no “Name” column.
error.tooManyRows: The table has more than 5,000 rows – the app cannot handle that many tasks.
error.invalid: The table data did not pass the check.
error.nameTooLong: the name is longer than 200 characters.
error.notesTooLong: the note is longer than 5,000 characters.
error.badLevel: invalid level (a whole number 1–6, at most 1 more than the previous row).
error.badDuration: the duration must be a whole number of days (0–10,000).
error.badPercent: % complete must be a whole number 0–100.
error.badDate: invalid “Start no earlier than” date (use e.g. 2026-11-18).
error.badNumber: the row number (No.) must be a positive whole number.
error.duplicateNumber: another row already has the same row number (No.).
error.unknownPredecessor: a predecessor refers to a row number that is not in the table.
error.selfDependency: a task cannot be its own predecessor.
error.phaseDependency: a phase cannot have a link (nor be a predecessor).
error.parentNotPhase: sub-items can only be under a phase (check the Level and Type columns).
error.cycle: the links form a loop (the task waits for itself through other tasks).

export.failed: The export failed. Please try again.

autosave.restored: Your unfinished project was restored from the browser backup ({{date}}).
autosave.corrupted: The browser backup of your unfinished project is damaged, so it was not used. If you have the project saved in a file, open it via File → Open.

file.newHint: Start with an empty project (asks first if there are unsaved changes)
file.openHint: Open a project from a .json file
file.saveHint: Save the project to a file (asks where the first time)
file.saveAsHint: Save the project to a new file
file.exportXlsxHint: Save the task list as an Excel workbook (recommended for editing in Excel)
file.exportCsvHint: Save the task list as CSV (for other programs; Excel may convert some values to dates)
file.fileNameHint: The file the project is saved to
file.unsavedHint: The project has changes that are not saved in the file. Save it with File → Save (Ctrl+S).
file.confirmDiscard: The project has unsaved changes. Continue anyway? You can still undo them (Ctrl+Z), but they are not saved in the file.
file.importHint: Replace the tasks with a table from an .xlsx or .csv file (you will see a preview first)

error.tooLarge: The file is too large (over 5 MB) – it is probably not a GanttBudget project. Nothing has changed.
error.notJson: The file cannot be read – it is damaged or not a project file (.json). Nothing has changed.
error.notProject: This file is not a GanttBudget project. Nothing has changed.
error.newerVersion: The file is from a newer version of the app (format {{version}}). Please update the app. Nothing has changed.
error.invalid_one: The project file contains invalid data ({{count}} problem, e.g. in “{{where}}”). It was probably edited by hand or damaged. Nothing has changed.
error.invalid_other: The project file contains invalid data ({{count}} problems, e.g. in “{{where}}”). It was probably edited by hand or damaged. Nothing has changed.
error.saveFailed: The project could not be saved (the file may be open elsewhere or permission is missing). Try Save as…
error.openFailed: The file could not be opened. Please try again.

toolbar.label: Main tools
toolbar.loadSampleHint: Load the sample project “Introducing production automation”
toolbar.calendarHint: Project start, working days, holidays and shutdowns
toolbar.shortcutsHint: Overview of keyboard shortcuts and mouse controls (F1)

table.caption: Project task list
table.collapseHint: Hide the tasks of this phase (in the table and the chart)
table.expandHint: Show the tasks of this phase
table.confirmDeleteWithChildren_one: Really delete phase “{{name}}” including {{count}} item inside it? You can undo this with Undo (Ctrl+Z).
table.confirmDeleteWithChildren_other: Really delete phase “{{name}}” including {{count}} items inside it? You can undo this with Undo (Ctrl+Z).
table.startHint: Start. If you change it, the task starts no earlier than this date (📌 – same as moving the bar). Clear the date to remove the constraint.
table.finishHint: Finish = last working day. If you change it, the duration in working days is recalculated.
table.milestoneFinishHint: A milestone lasts 0 days – its finish equals its start. Move the start instead.
table.invalidDate: That is not a valid date – the previous value was restored.
table.finishBeforeStart: The finish cannot be before the start ({{start}}). The previous value was restored.
table.constraint: Starts no earlier than {{date}} (set by moving the bar or in the table). Click to remove the constraint – Ctrl+Z undoes it.
table.constraintIgnored: Starts no earlier than {{date}} – but right now a dependency on a predecessor only allows a later start. Click to remove the constraint.
table.constraintClear: Remove the “start no earlier than {{date}}” constraint from task {{name}}
table.resizeHint: Drag to change the column width. Double-click = default width. From the keyboard: arrows ←/→ (with Shift in bigger steps), Home = default.
table.dragHint: Drag the row elsewhere. Over a phase: top part = before it, middle = into it, bottom part = after it. Esc cancels.
table.kindLockedHint: This phase contains tasks, so it must stay a phase. To change it, move its tasks out first.
table.wbsHint: Number in the project breakdown (WBS – Work Breakdown Structure). E.g. 2.3 = third item of the second phase. Predecessors are written with row numbers from the No. column.
table.name: Name
table.durationHint: Number of working days. A milestone has duration 0.
table.datesHint: Calculated automatically from duration, predecessors and the calendar. Finish = last working day.
table.phaseDatesHint: A phase runs from the start of its first task to the finish of its last task – calculated automatically.
table.phaseDurationHint: Number of working days from the start to the finish of the phase. Calculated from its tasks.
table.predecessorsHint: Row numbers this task follows. E.g. 2; 5+3 = after the finish of row 2 and 3 working days after the finish of row 5. Dependency type after the number: FS (default, not written) = starts after finish, SS = starts with start, FF = finishes with finish, SF = finishes before start – e.g. 3SS+2.
table.phasePredecessorsHint: A phase cannot have predecessors yet.
table.cycleHint: Dates cannot be calculated: the links form a loop (the task waits for itself). Fix the predecessors.
table.confirmDelete: Really delete “{{name}}”? You can undo this with Undo (Ctrl+Z).
table.emptyText: Start by adding your first task, or have a look at the sample project.
table.invalidName: The name cannot be empty – the original value was restored.
table.confirmDeleteMany_one: Really delete {{count}} item (the selected rows including items in selected phases)? You can undo this with Undo (Ctrl+Z).
table.confirmDeleteMany_other: Really delete {{count}} items (the selected rows including items in selected phases)? You can undo this with Undo (Ctrl+Z).

kind.taskHint: Work that takes a certain number of days.
kind.phaseHint: A group of tasks (a project stage).
kind.milestoneHint: An important moment with no duration, e.g. signing a contract.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: Shortcuts work with the selected row (click into it). On a Mac, use Cmd instead of Ctrl.

items.save: Save the project to a file
items.saveAs: Save the project to a new file
items.open: Open a project from a file
items.addTask: New task below the selected row
items.duplicate: Duplicate the selected rows (phases including their tasks)
items.delete: Delete the selected rows (outside a text field – in a field Ctrl+Delete deletes a word)
items.indent: Indent – put under the row above (into a phase)
items.outdent: Outdent – move one level up, after the end of the phase
items.undo: Undo the last change (outside a text field; in a field it undoes typing)
items.confirm: Confirm the edit of a field
items.cancel: Cancel the edit of a field or a drag; outside a field, clear a multiple selection
items.nextField: Go to the next field (Shift+Tab to the previous one)

mouseItems.dragBar: Drag a bar in the chart = move the task (sets “start no earlier than” 📌).
mouseItems.dragEdge: Drag the edge of a bar = change the start or finish (duration).
mouseItems.dragRow: Drag a row by ⠿ = move it elsewhere or into a phase.
mouseItems.resizeColumn: Drag the right edge of a column header = change its width; double-click = default width.
mouseItems.drawLink: Drag from the circle at the start / finish of a bar onto another task = draw a dependency (type FS, SS, FF, SF depending on where from and where to).
mouseItems.pin: Click 📌 = remove the “start no earlier than” constraint.
mouseItems.collapse: Click ▾ / ▸ = collapse or expand a phase.
mouseItems.zoom: Ctrl + mouse wheel or spreading / pinching two fingers on the touchpad over the chart = more / less detailed timeline (the day under the pointer stays in place).
mouseItems.multiSelect: Ctrl + click a row or bar = add it to / remove it from the selection; Shift + click = select a continuous range. Buttons, shortcuts and dragging then work with all selected rows.
mouseItems.dragGroup: Drag one of the selected bars = move all selected by the same number of working days; drag ⠿ of a selected row = move the whole selection.

structure.indentHint: Put the selected rows under the row above them (into a phase) – Alt+Shift+→
structure.outdentHint: Move the selected rows one level up, after the end of their phase – Alt+Shift+←
structure.moveUpHint: Move the selected rows (with their tasks) up – Alt+Shift+↑
structure.moveDownHint: Move the selected rows (with their tasks) down – Alt+Shift+↓
structure.noSelection: First click into the row you want to work with.
structure.confirmConvert_one: Row “{{name}}” will become a phase so it can contain tasks. Phases cannot have dependencies yet, so {{count}} dependency will be removed. Continue? (Ctrl+Z undoes it.)
structure.confirmConvert_other: Row “{{name}}” will become a phase so it can contain tasks. Phases cannot have dependencies yet, so {{count}} dependencies will be removed. Continue? (Ctrl+Z undoes it.)

error.notFound: The selected row no longer exists. Click into another row.
error.noPreviousSibling: There is nothing above this row on the same level. It cannot be indented or moved up.
error.noNextSibling: There is nothing below this row on the same level. Move it to another phase by outdenting or dragging.
error.topLevel: The row is already at the top level.
error.maxDepth: A plan can have at most {{max}} levels. The row cannot go any deeper.
error.targetNotPhase: A row can only be placed inside a phase.
error.intoOwnSubtree: A phase cannot be moved into itself or into its own tasks.

structure.selectedHint: Ctrl+click adds or removes a row, Shift+click selects a range, Esc clears the selection
structure.confirmConvertMany_one: Rows above the selection will become phases so they can contain tasks. Phases cannot have dependencies yet, so {{count}} dependency will be removed. Continue? (Ctrl+Z undoes it.)
structure.confirmConvertMany_other: Rows above the selection will become phases so they can contain tasks. Phases cannot have dependencies yet, so {{count}} dependencies will be removed. Continue? (Ctrl+Z undoes it.)

gantt.chartLabel: Gantt chart – timeline of the tasks. The same data is in the table on the left.
gantt.splitterHint: Drag with the mouse, or use the left/right arrow keys
gantt.zoomHint: How much detail of time to show in the chart. Over the chart you can also use Ctrl + mouse wheel or two fingers on the touchpad.
gantt.dragTaskHint: Drag the bar to move it, its edges to change the start or finish, the circle next to the bar for a new dependency. Esc cancels.
gantt.linkHandle: Drag onto another task to create a dependency. Left half of the target = to its start, right half = to its finish.

linkInvalid.phaseSuccessor: A phase cannot have predecessors yet
linkInvalid.cycle: This would create a loop – the task would wait for itself

gantt.dragMilestoneHint: Drag the milestone to move it. Esc cancels.
gantt.phaseNotDraggable: A phase is calculated from its tasks – move or change its tasks instead.
gantt.constraintOverridden: “{{name}}” cannot start earlier than its predecessors allow (dependency). The “start no earlier than” date was saved, but the dependency wins. To move it earlier, change its predecessors.
gantt.constraintOverriddenMany_one: For {{count}} moved task a dependency applies, so it starts later than where you moved it. The constraint was saved (📌).
gantt.constraintOverriddenMany_other: For {{count}} moved tasks a dependency applies, so they start later than where you moved them. The constraints were saved (📌).

predecessorError.syntax: “{{token}}” is not a valid predecessor entry. Write row numbers separated by semicolons, optionally with a dependency type (FS, SS, FF, SF) and lag, e.g. 2; 5+3; 6SS+2.
predecessorError.duplicate: Row {{row}} is listed twice among the predecessors.
predecessorError.phase: Row {{row}} is a phase. Linking to phases is not possible yet – link to its last task instead.
predecessorError.phaseSuccessor: A phase cannot have predecessors yet.
predecessorError.cycle: This link would create a loop {{path}} – the task would wait for itself.

schedule.noWorkingDays: The calendar has no working day, so no dates can be calculated. Adjust it under Calendar.

calendar.title: Project calendar
calendar.intro: Dates are calculated in working days only. Weekends, holidays and shutdowns are skipped.
calendar.projectStartHint: The first tasks start on the nearest working day from this date.
calendar.atLeastOneDay: At least one day of the week must be a working day.
calendar.czechHolidays: Automatically include Czech public holidays (including Easter)
calendar.customIntro: E.g. company holiday or production shutdown. For a single day, enter the same date in both fields.
calendar.customMissingDates: Fill in both the from and to dates.
calendar.customEndBeforeStart: The “to” date cannot be before the “from” date.

holiday.newYear: New Year's Day, Restoration Day of the Independent Czech State
holiday.freedomDay: Struggle for Freedom and Democracy Day
